answer_2.quote: we propose a novel metric for evaluating LLM-generated event graphs, called Hungarian Graph Similarity (HGS).

answer_3.quote: For each relation edge generated, we pose a question to the LLMs to determine whether the relation is grounded in the given document.

answer_4.quote: We recruited additional annotators to evaluate the generated graph on 50 of the test documents.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked whether the relation edges are correct.
